vision.title: Our Vision
paragraphs: Collaboration across sectors in all fields has increasingly focused on harnessing the smart digital revolution to advance to higher levels of performance and organization, directly reflecting on their growth and facilitating communication along every link of their production chain. Among the most prominent of these sectors is the transportation sector in all its specializations.
From this, Safaryat was born with a vision to contribute to developing an electronic system that serves the land passenger transport sector.
One that simplifies the booking process between carriers and travelers with the best solutions and highest standards.

how.title: How It Works
how.subtitle: Simple and fast — just three steps

travelers.title: For Travelers
steps: Set your destination and travel date
Choose the right carrier for you
Confirm your booking and enjoy the trip

carriers.title: For Carriers
steps: Add your available trips and routes

paragraphs: Safaryat targeted the land passenger transport industry and the huge volume of services it provides throughout its entire production chain — identifying the most important areas that need modern tools to positively impact the outputs of this industry.

items.title: Offering travel deals by transport companies.
paragraphs: Safaryat developed an electronic platform that allows travel companies to organize their trip programs 45 days in advance, enabling real-time awareness of reservations and pre-occupancy of seats, as well as presenting incentive offers to travelers.

items.title: Remote booking system for travelers.
paragraphs: Travelers can view multiple trip options offered by companies and choose what suits their travel requirements in terms of company, vehicle, time, number of seats, and prices. Safaryat acts as a link and mediator between land travelers and all categories of public transportation companies.
